subject: Re: MAP & Security deliverables — SOC 2 / DPA / retention checkpoints
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@finsolve.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finsolve.com, Ben Hall <benjamin.hall@finsolve.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP + Security gating items for purchase approval

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile. Procurement asked me to put timelines / owners together for the security gating before we can move to PO. High level asks from our side: SOC 2 report (most recent), completed SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet, DPA redline that our legal team can review, and a confirmation of your data retention defaults and audit log retention.

Can we get a mutual action plan with target dates for each of these? Ideal close for us is end of July (7/31) but we may need to accelerate SOC 2 evidence.

Appreciate your help — looping procurement and Ben from Legal.

Best,
Emily Carter
Dir., IT & Security
FinSolve

[Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@finsolve.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + Security gating items for purchase approval

Emily — thanks for the clear ask. I put together a working MAP and attached the timeline; summary below with owners. Please flag anything missing and we can finalize.

MAP (draft)
- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood to provide latest auditor report and control summary — Acct owner: Karthik Iyer — Target: 2026-07-08 (deliverable: redwood-soc2-audit-2025.pdf).
- SIG/CAIQ: Completed spreadsheet with Yes/Planned/NA and compensating controls — Acct owner: Karthik — Target: 2026-07-06 (deliverable: redwood-sig-caic-spreadsheet.xlsx).
- DPA: Legal redline response and execution plan — Acct owner: Marissa Cole (sales/legal coordination) — Target: first redline response 2026-07-09; final execution by 2026-07-20.
- Data retention & logs: thread to confirm production retention defaults (tokens/meta) and audit log retention — Acct owner: Soojin Lee — Target: 2026-07-02 (summary below).
- Final commercial close (PO/Signature): Target: 2026-07-31 (FinSolve preferred).

Quick note on retention (default configs):
- In hosted Redwood API: conversational input/outputs retained 90 days by default for troubleshooting; can be reduced to 0 days under private deployment or with explicit contract terms.
- Audit logs and request metadata: retained 365 days for compliance and traceability; exportable on request, subject to Egress/retention SLA.
- For regulated workloads, we recommend Redwood Private (VPC) with customer-managed KMS; that removes retention of production prompts in our hosted aggregation storage.

I've attached the MAP spreadsheet and the SOC 2 artifact. Karthik / Marissa — can you review SOC evidence + DPA approach and mark any blockers?

Thanks,
Soojin
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

[Attachments: map-eval-timeline-2026.xlsx, redwood-soc2-audit-2025.pdf, redwood-sig-caic-spreadsheet.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@finsolve.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-30T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + Security gating items for purchase approval

Emily — quick clarifying notes from the InfoSec side (cc Marissa for commercial):
1) SOC 2: The PDF provided is the 2025 Type II report. It contains control assertions and the auditor summary. We can provide a control matrix export for the exact control mappings to your SIG questions if that helps with procurement. Target for the control matrix export: 2026-07-06.
2) SIG/CAIQ: The spreadsheet uses the standard responses; items marked "Planned" have estimated remediation/controls in place timelines. Important callout: one item about tenant-level key isolation is marked "Planned" — for FinSolve's production tenant we can offer tenant KMS + dedicated VLAN via Redwood Private, timeline 4–6 weeks post-contract.
3) DPA redline: I reviewed the RDW-4582 proposed redline (attached by Marissa) and flagged two common commercial asks: retention override clause and subprocessor list. We can provide a subprocessor register and an SLA for data export within 7 days. Marissa, can Legal prepare the first response to Ben?

Karthik
Principal Applied ML Engineer | Redwood Inference

[Attachment referenced inline: control-matrix-export.csv (will deliver 2026-07-06)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Hall <benjamin.hall@finsolve.com>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@finsolve.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP + Security gating items for purchase approval

Ben/Emily — forwarding our MAP draft and proposed timeline. Quick commercial notes:
- We can agree to the 7/31 commercial target provided SOC evidence and DPA redline happen on the schedule above.
- For procurement: if you need an executed DPA before PO, we can prioritize the redline response and push the final signature window to 7/20.
- If FinSolve requires tenant isolation or KMS, we'll need to align on Redwood Private onboarding timeline; that may move the final delivery date beyond 7/31 depending on procurement lead time.

Action items for Ben: please confirm whether procurement requires signed DPA before issuing PO. If yes, we will aim to get a redline response by 7/09 and escalate legal as needed.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: rdw-dpa-redline-v1.docx]

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@finsolve.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Hall <benjamin.hall@finsolve.com>, procurement@finsolve.com
Date: 2026-07-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + Security gating items for purchase approval

All — thanks, this is helpful. Confirming our internal procurement requirement: we prefer DPA executed prior to PO if there are material changes to retention or subprocessors. Ben, please advise but aim for signature by 7/20.

Next steps I see:
- Redwood delivers control matrix export and completed SIG spreadsheet by 7/06 (Karthik).
- Redwood legal to provide first DPA redline response by 7/09 (Marissa).
- Soojin to confirm final retention/export mechanics and the ability to scope retention to 0 days for hosted test tenants or move to Private for production.
- Follow-up sync on 2026-07-08 to close any open items and confirm commercial readiness.

If all on track we will proceed to PO with 7/31 target.

Emily
Dir., IT & Security | FinSolve
